warnings: 2nd-floor beam plan (แปลนคาน พื้นชั้น 2 1:100). The floor carries a 2.00 balcony all round: B13 cantilevers on every grid (and every column row at grids 1 and 10), B12 edge beams (B12' at the corners), B23/B23' along rows A and G, B18 on the inner grid lines 1 and 10.

Secondary beams B14 are NOT dimensioned: in the interior bays 2-9 they sit at the third points of the 8.00 spans A-C and E-G (scaled 2.667 / 5.333 / 14.667 / 17.333) plus on rows C, D, E; in the end bays 1-2 and 9-10 they sit every 2.00 (scaled 2.00 / 6.00 / 14.00 / 18.00) with B23' on rows B, F (and C, E in bay 1-2). Third-point and mid-point lines are scaled_from_grid (grid master per-line flags); spans along them are grid spans. Second op04 pass (2026-10-22): the stage framing plan on หน้า06 prints 1.00 + 1.00 from rows B and F, so the 6.00 and 14.00 lines are printed positions now (their 4 B14 segments lost the scaled flag); the third-point lines stay scaled.
Grids 2 and 9 carry B17 split at a small post 'เสา .15 x .15 ม.' on rows B and F; grids 3-8 carry B15 as single 8.00 members A-C / E-G; every interior grid carries B16' C-E.

REVERSED in the second op04 pass (2026-10-22) — the first pass wrote: 'NOT recorded (judgement, not missed): the left stair junction at row D beyond grid 1 (B19, B4' 'เอียงตามบันได', B13'), the left balcony edge between rows C and E (interrupted by the stair), the right stair landing framing between rows C and E in bay 10-11 (B19, B20, B14 — only B21 on grid 11 recorded), and the sub-beams 'B' / B9 inside the S3 group of bay 1-2 rows F-G.' All of them are now in elements: left stair — B12 continued C→C' and D'→E on the 1'''' balcony line, B4' (header, rotated label beside the 1'''' line at row D; section B-B cuts it at the top of the flights) C'→D→D', B13' (landing beams, both leader arrows end on the landing edge 1'') C'→D→D', and the shaded band along row D from column D1'' to the 1'''' line carrying two labels (B19 under it, 'B4' เอียงตามบันได' pointing at the flight edge beside it) — recorded as both members on the same plan line with low scores, because the plan cannot say whether the label pair is one sloped member or a level beam plus a sloped stringer (section B-B shows a solid flight and a dashed sloped B4'); a consumer summing concrete should treat that pair as possibly one member. Right stair — B19 on rows C and E (10→10''→11; the 10→10'' piece has no label of its own), B20 11→11' to the stub columns, B14 on the 10'' line and on grid 11 between C and E. S3 group — two short 'B' beams (x scaled 1.35 / 2.75), the B14 under the cubicle front at y 17.00 (printed 1.00 on หน้า06, drawn ≈1.5), and B9 at x 1.875 (from ขยาย S3 1.65 | .15 | 1.90) down to row G.
Note on the sheet: 'เสาเอ็น 0.30x0.30 4-ø19 มม. ป ø6 มม. @0.15' at the stair-landing columns on grid 11 (B20).

B21 position corrected (second op04 pass, 2026-10-22): the first pass recorded B21 on grid 11 (C11→E11). Re-read at 4.6x: grid 11 between rows C and E carries the double line with the two columns C11 / E11 and a vertical 'B14' label beside it; 'B21' is printed to the right of the next line out (measured ≈40.9, the 1.10 line 11' = 41.10 of the ground-floor plan), whose ends hold the hatched 'เสาเอ็น 0.30x0.30' squares that the B20 stubs from C11 / E11 reach. B21 is now C11'→E11'; the grid-11 member is B14.
